content.title: Does Citizens Financial Group Offer Value After Recent Share Price Dip in 2025?
content.summary: Thinking about whether to hang onto Citizens Financial Group stock, take profits, or make a fresh buy? You are definitely not alone. After all, the stock's recent performance has left many investors debating what comes next. Despite a choppy seven days, with shares slipping 6.9%, Citizens still finds itself well in the green over longer stretches. The stock is up 20.7% over the past year, and an impressive 134.5% from where it sat five years ago. These are not just numbers; they are signs...

content.title: Big bank earnings, Fed commentary: What to Watch
content.description:
Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come in the week ahead, including corporate earnings from a variety of companies like major banks JPMorgan (JPM), Wells Fargo (WFC), Goldman Sachs (GS), Citi (C), Bank of America (BAC), and Morgan Stanley (MS); a slew of commentary from Federal Reserve officials; and the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) working to have September's Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data ready by October 24.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.

content.title: Renewed Trade-War Fears Ding Bank Stocks
content.summary: Investors sold off bank stocks Friday after President Trump renewed fears of a trade war with China. Among the hardest hit: regional banks. Without big trading businesses that help Wall Street firms profit off of market volatility, regional banks could be more exposed to any economic fallout of the trade dispute.
